integrity: All radical identities and positivity conditions are reconstructed explicitly. The finite algebra is replayed by an exact-arithmetic checker; the passage from the verified dihedral system to a simplex with regular Morley simplex uses Lemma 9.1 of the cited primary source.
scientific_limitations: The result certifies one exact nonregular N=6 circulant solution. It does not classify the N=6 system, exclude other branches, or prove the dimension-five two-reflection conjecture for arbitrary five-simplices.
title: A radical nonregular five-simplex with regular Morley simplex
